Cashless where eligible. Website's 4 steps: 1) Inspection - multi-point check and computerised diagnostics; 2) Estimate - transparent, itemised quote with only the required repairs, approved by you before work starts; 3) Repair - by trained, brand-experienced technicians with genuine OEM/OES parts; 4) Delivery - washed, quality-checked and ready for the road, with a written warranty card.
/insurance-claim.time: Most claims are processed within 4-7 working days (site FAQ). After approval: minor accident jobs 3-5 working days, major structural/multi-panel repairs 1-2 weeks subject to parts (Accidental Claim page).
/insurance-claim.warranty: Written warranty card with every job; the exact warranty depends on the work and the part and is confirmed by the team (the site's '1 Year Service Warranty' badge differs from per-service cards such as 1 month / 1000 km).
/insurance-claim.parts: 100% genuine OEM/OES parts with manufacturer warranty (site badge and 'Services included').

faq.q_hi: Kya insurance claim cashless hota hai?
faq.a_hi: Haan, hum sabhi major insurance companies ke saath cashless claim directly coordinate karte hain. Paperwork, surveyor aur approval hamari team handle karti hai.
faq.q_en: Is the insurance claim cashless?
faq.a_en: Yes, we coordinate cashless claims directly with all major insurance providers; our team handles the paperwork, surveyor and approvals.

faq.q_hi: Insurance claim mein kitna time lagta hai?
faq.a_hi: Zyadatar claims 4 se 7 working days mein process ho jaate hain. Approval ke baad chhota accident kaam 3 se 5 working days, bada structural kaam parts ke hisaab se 1 se 2 hafte.
faq.q_en: How long does an insurance claim take?
faq.a_en: Most claims are processed within 4 to 7 working days. After approval, minor accident jobs take 3 to 5 working days and major structural repairs 1 to 2 weeks, subject to parts.

faq.q_hi: Insurance claim ke liye kaun se documents chahiye?
faq.a_hi: Aam taur par insurance policy ki details, damage ki photos, police report agar zaroori ho, aur repair ke bills ya receipts chahiye hote hain.
faq.q_en: What documents do I need for an insurance claim?
faq.a_en: Usually your insurance policy details, photos of the damage, a police report if applicable, and any repair invoices or receipts.

faq.q_hi: Cashless claim mein mujhe kuch pay karna padega?
faq.a_hi: Cashless claim mein aapko policy ka deductible, depreciation (plastic, rubber, paint parts par) aur jo cover nahi hai wo dena hota hai. Hum ye sab pehle hi itemise karke bata dete hain.
faq.q_en: Will I have to pay anything on a cashless claim?
faq.a_en: You pay the policy deductible plus depreciation on plastic, rubber and paint parts, and anything not covered. We itemise it all upfront.

faq.q_hi: Chhote damage ke liye claim karna chahiye kya?
faq.a_hi: Hamesha nahi. Chhota claim aapka No-Claim Bonus reset kar deta hai, jo repair se mehnga pad sakta hai. Hum claim aur cash dono ka honest comparison dete hain, phir aap decide karte hain.
faq.q_en: Is it worth claiming for minor accident damage?
faq.a_en: Not always: a small claim resets your No-Claim Bonus, which can cost more over time than the repair. We give you an honest claim-versus-pay comparison first.

faq.q_hi: Accident ke turant baad kya karna chahiye?
faq.a_hi: Pehle safe jagah par jaiye, damage aur jagah ki photos lijiye, doosri gaadi ki details note kijiye aur policy window mein insurer ko inform kijiye, aksar 24 se 48 ghante. Bade damage ya injury par FIR kijiye, phir ACR ko call kijiye.
faq.q_en: What should I do right after an accident?
faq.a_en: Move to safety, photograph the damage and the scene, note the other vehicle's details and inform your insurer within the policy window, often 24 to 48 hours. For major damage or injury file an FIR, then call ACR.

faq.q_hi: Insurance claim ke liye pickup milega?
faq.a_hi: Haan, pickup aur drop complimentary hai, poore Delhi NCR mein. Team aapke ghar ya office se gaadi le jaati hai aur kaam ke baad wapas chhod deti hai.
faq.q_en: Is pickup available for an insurance claim?
faq.a_en: Yes, pickup and drop is complimentary across Delhi NCR. The team collects the car from your home or office and returns it after the work.

/category/car-brake-wheel-maintenance.process: Brake jobs include brake, caliper/rotor and hardware inspection; disc turning includes disc thickness measurement and runout check. Discs above minimum thickness are machined, below spec they are replaced. Vibration is diagnosed (wheel balance vs warped disc vs suspension) before work.

/category/car-brake-wheel-maintenance.parts: 100% genuine OEM/OES parts with manufacturer warranty (site badge and 'Services included').

faq.q_hi: Brake pad kab badalne chahiye?
faq.a_hi: Jab brake lagate waqt cheekhne ya ghisne ki awaaz aaye, pedal zyada neeche jaaye ya vibration ho. Zyadatar pads 30,000 se 50,000 km chalte hain; kisi bhi centre par pad thickness free mein naap dete hain.
faq.q_en: When do brake pads need changing?
faq.a_en: When you hear squealing or grinding, the pedal travels further, or braking vibrates. Most pads last 30,000 to 50,000 km; we measure pad thickness free at any centre.

faq.q_hi: Alignment aur balancing mein kya fark hai?
faq.a_hi: Alignment wheel ke angles set karta hai taaki gaadi seedhi chale aur tyre barabar ghisein; balancing wheel ka weight theek karta hai taaki vibration na ho. Dono alag problem solve karte hain, kai gaadiyon ko dono chahiye.
faq.q_en: What is the difference between alignment and balancing?
faq.a_en: Alignment sets the wheel angles so the car tracks straight and tyres wear evenly; balancing corrects weight distribution so the wheel spins without vibration. Many cars need both.

faq.q_hi: Brake disc badalna padega ya turning se ho jayega?
faq.a_hi: Agar disc minimum thickness se upar hai aur halka scored ya warped hai to turning se theek ho jata hai; spec se kam, cracked ya gehre groove wali disc badalni padti hai.
faq.q_en: Should brake discs be replaced or machined?
faq.a_en: If the disc is above minimum thickness and only lightly scored or warped, turning restores it; below spec, cracked or heavily grooved discs must be replaced.

faq.q_hi: Highway par steering kyun vibrate karta hai?
faq.a_hi: Aksar wheels unbalanced hote hain, lekin brake lagane par vibration ho to disc warped ho sakti hai, ya suspension ghisa hua. Hum asli wajah diagnose karte hain.
faq.q_en: Why does my steering vibrate at highway speed?
faq.a_en: Most often unbalanced wheels, but it can be a warped brake disc (vibration only when braking) or worn suspension. We diagnose the exact cause.

faq.q_hi: Kaise pata chalega ki wheel alignment chahiye?
faq.a_hi: Gaadi ek side kheenche, seedha chalate waqt steering tedha rahe, ya tyre ek kinare se zyada ghisein. Kerb ya gaddhe ki takkar ya suspension kaam ke baad alignment zaroori hai.
faq.q_en: How do I know my car needs wheel alignment?
faq.a_en: The car pulls to one side, the steering wheel sits off-centre when driving straight, or the tyres wear unevenly. After a kerb or pothole hit or suspension work, alignment is a must.

faq.q_hi: Wheel alignment kitni baar karwani chahiye?
faq.a_hi: Ye gaadi aur driving par depend karta hai, aam taur par kuch hazaar km ya kuch mahine mein ek baar; kerb ya gaddhe ki takkar ya suspension kaam ke baad zaroor karwaiye. Aapki gaadi ke liye sahi interval team batayegi.
faq.q_en: How often should I get a wheel alignment?
faq.a_en: It depends on the car and your driving, typically every few thousand km or few months, and always after a kerb or pothole hit or suspension work. The team will tell you the right interval for your car.

faq.q_hi: Wheel alignment se mileage badhta hai kya?
faq.a_hi: Haan, sahi alignment se rolling resistance kam hota hai, isse fuel efficiency behtar hoti hai aur tyre zyada chalte hain.
faq.q_en: Can wheel alignment improve fuel efficiency?
faq.a_en: Yes, proper alignment reduces rolling resistance, which improves fuel efficiency and extends tyre life.

faq.q_hi: Suspension kharab hone ke kya lakshan hain?

faq.q_hi: Shocker dono side badalne padenge?

faq.q_en: Should shock absorbers be replaced in pairs?
faq.a_en: Yes, shock absorbers and most arms should be replaced axle-wise in pairs so both sides respond evenly; replacing just one makes the car feel lopsided.

faq.q_hi: AC thanda nahi kar raha, kya problem ho sakti hai?
faq.a_hi: Aksar dheere leak se gas kam hoti hai, condenser dhool se band hota hai, ya compressor kamzor hota hai. Pressure test aur condenser cleaning se cooling wapas aati hai; bina leak dhundhe gas bharna sirf problem ko taalna hai.
faq.q_en: My car AC is not cooling, what could it be?
faq.a_en: Usually low refrigerant from a slow leak, a condenser blocked by dust, or a tired compressor. A pressure test and condenser clean restore cooling; topping up gas without finding the leak only delays the problem.

faq.q_hi: Periodic AC service mein kya hota hai?
faq.a_hi: AC inspection, AC gas top-up 400 gram, AC filter cleaning, AC vent cleaning aur condenser cleaning. Ye har 5,000 km ya 3 mahine par recommended hai.
faq.q_en: What is included in a periodic AC service?
faq.a_en: AC inspection, an AC gas top-up of 400 g, AC filter cleaning, AC vent cleaning and condenser cleaning. Recommended every 5,000 km or 3 months.

faq.q_hi: Full AC service mein kya hota hai?
faq.a_hi: Cooling coil cleaning, dashboard kholkar wapas fitting, compressor oil 200 ml tak aur AC gas top-up 600 gram. Ye har 10,000 km ya saal mein ek baar recommended hai.
faq.q_en: What is included in a full AC service?
faq.a_en: Cooling coil cleaning, dashboard removal and refitting, compressor oil up to 200 ml and an AC gas top-up of 600 g. Recommended every 10,000 km or once a year.

faq.q_hi: AC gas refill se cooling hamesha ke liye theek ho jayegi?
faq.a_hi: Sirf tab jab gas bas kam thi. Agar leak hai, jo aam wajah hai, to refill temporary hai aur gas kuch hafton mein nikal jaati hai. Isliye hum pehle leak test karte hain.
faq.q_en: Will an AC gas refill fix poor cooling permanently?
faq.a_en: Only if the gas was simply low. If there is a leak, the usual reason, the refill is temporary and the gas escapes within weeks, so we leak-test first.

faq.q_hi: AC se badboo kyun aati hai?
faq.a_hi: Geele evaporator aur purane cabin filter par fungus aur bacteria jam jaate hain, khaas kar monsoon ke baad. Anti-bacterial evaporator treatment aur naya cabin filter smell hata deta hai.
faq.q_en: Why does my AC smell musty?
faq.a_en: Mould and bacteria build up on a damp evaporator and an old cabin filter, common after the monsoon. An anti-bacterial evaporator treatment and a new cabin filter clear the smell.

faq.q_hi: Full AC service mein kitna time lagta hai?
faq.a_hi: Full AC service mein kaam ke hisaab se 2 se 8 ghante lag sakte hain; exact time team inspection ke baad batayegi.
faq.q_en: How long does a full AC service take?
faq.a_en: A full AC service can take 2 to 8 hours depending on the work; the team will tell you the exact time after inspection.

faq.q_hi: AC service par warranty milti hai?
faq.a_hi: Haan, periodic AC service par 500 km ya 1 mahine ki, aur full AC service par 1000 km ya 1 mahine ki warranty hai.
faq.q_en: Is there a warranty on AC service?
faq.a_en: Yes: periodic AC service carries 500 km or 1 month, full AC service 1000 km or 1 month.

/category/car-emergency-services.process: Call the helpline with your exact location; the nearest unit is dispatched. The car is photographed before loading and is covered in transit. Flat-bed for AWD, low-clearance, luxury and non-rolling cars; wheel-lift for short hops of standard cars.

faq.q_hi: Gaadi kharab ho gayi, kitni der mein madad pahunchegi?

faq.q_en: How quickly can you reach me if I break down?
faq.a_en: Across most of Delhi NCR the response is typically 30 to 60 minutes, depending on traffic and your distance from our 4 centres. Call with your exact location and we dispatch the nearest unit.

faq.q_hi: Flatbed aur wheel-lift towing mein kya fark hai?
faq.a_hi: Flatbed charon pahiye utha leta hai, AWD, low-clearance, luxury ya na chalne wali gaadi ke liye sabse safe. Wheel-lift ek axle uthata hai, chhoti doori ke liye standard gaadi ke liye.
faq.q_en: What is the difference between flat-bed and wheel-lift towing?
faq.a_en: A flat-bed lifts all four wheels, safest for AWD, low-clearance, luxury and non-rolling cars. A wheel-lift raises one axle and suits short hops of standard cars.

faq.q_hi: Towing ke time gaadi safe aur insured rehti hai?
faq.a_hi: Haan, gaadi transit mein covered rehti hai, aur load karne se pehle uski photo lete hain taaki condition record rahe.
faq.q_en: Is my car safe and insured during towing?
faq.a_en: Yes, your vehicle is covered in transit, and we photograph it before loading so its condition is documented.

faq.q_hi: Baar baar jump start karna pad raha hai, kya karein?
faq.a_hi: Baar baar jump-start ka matlab alternator ya battery mein fault hai, jise diagnose karna chahiye. Galat polarity se ECU kharab ho sakta hai, isliye doubt ho to call kijiye.
faq.q_en: My car keeps needing a jump-start, what should I do?
faq.a_en: Repeated jump-starts point to an alternator or battery fault that should be diagnosed. Wrong polarity can damage the ECU, so call us if unsure.

faq.q_hi: Engine check light jal rahi hai, kya gaadi chala sakte hain?
faq.a_hi: Steady light ka matlab hai dhyan se chalaiye aur jaldi scan karwaiye; blink karti light serious misfire hai, gaadi rok dijiye taaki catalytic converter kharab na ho. Engine scan se pata chalta hai kaunsa case hai.
faq.q_en: My check engine light is on, is it safe to drive?
faq.a_en: A steady light usually means drive with caution and get it scanned soon; a flashing light signals a serious misfire, so stop driving to avoid catalytic-converter damage. A scan tells which it is.

faq.q_hi: Engine scanning mein kitna time lagta hai?
faq.a_hi: Basic scan mein 20 se 30 minute lagte hain; live data ke saath detailed diagnosis mein zyada. Repair quote se pehle codes aur unka matlab batate hain.
faq.q_en: How long does engine scanning take?
faq.a_en: A basic scan takes 20 to 30 minutes; a deeper live-data diagnosis takes longer. We share the codes and what they mean before quoting any repair.

faq.q_hi: Error code clear karne se problem theek ho jayegi?
faq.a_hi: Nahi, clear karne se sirf light reset hoti hai; asli fault rahega to light wapas aayegi. Hum wajah theek karte hain, phir clear karke road test karte hain.
faq.q_en: Will clearing the error code fix the problem?
faq.a_en: No, clearing only resets the light; if the fault remains it comes back. We fix the cause, then clear it and road-test.

faq.q_hi: Purane part wapas milenge kya?
faq.a_hi: Haan, badla hua har part aapko wapas diya jata hai, warranty ya core-return item ke alawa, aur batate hain ki wo kyun fail hua.
faq.q_en: Will you show me the old parts?
faq.a_en: Always. Every replaced part is returned to you, unless it is a warranty or core-return item, and we explain why it failed.

faq.q_hi: Alternator kharab hone ke kya signs hain?
faq.a_hi: Battery warning light jalna, lights ka dim ya flicker hona, whining awaaz, ya charge karne ke baad bhi battery baar baar khatam hona.
faq.q_en: How do I know my alternator is failing?
faq.a_en: A glowing battery warning light, dimming or flickering lights, a whining noise, or a battery that keeps dying despite charging.

/windshield-repair.title: Windshield Repair
/windshield-repair.process: Damaged area filled with specialised materials to restore strength and visibility; long, edge or line-of-sight cracks need full replacement; ADAS recalibrated after replacement.
/windshield-repair.time: A chip or short crack away from the edge can usually be resin-repaired same day; after replacement the safe drive-away time is typically 1-3 hours (Windshield Replacement page).
/windshield-repair.parts: OEM-grade glass with the correct tint, acoustic layer and sensor cut-outs (Windshield Replacement page).

faq.q_hi: Windshield ka crack repair ho jayega ya badalna padega?
faq.a_hi: Kinare se door chhota chip ya chhota crack, jo drivers ki nazar mein na ho, aam taur par usi din resin se repair ho jata hai. Lamba crack, kinare ka crack ya nazar ke saamne ka damage ho to poora windshield badalna padta hai.
faq.q_en: Can my windshield be repaired or does it need replacement?
faq.a_en: A chip or short crack away from the edge and outside your line of sight can usually be resin-repaired the same day. Long cracks, edge cracks or damage in the driver's view need a full replacement.

faq.q_hi: Windshield insurance mein badal jayega?
faq.a_hi: Comprehensive cover mein aam taur par haan, aur ACR par aksar cashless; kai policies mein glass alag cover hota hai jisse NCB par asar nahi padta. Kaam se pehle policy verify karte hain.
faq.q_en: Is windshield replacement covered by insurance?
faq.a_en: Usually yes under comprehensive cover, often cashless at ACR; many policies treat glass as a separate cover with no NCB impact. We verify your policy first.

faq.q_hi: Windshield badalne ke baad kab gaadi chala sakte hain?
faq.a_hi: Bonding ke liye aam taur par 1 se 3 ghante ka safe drive-away time chahiye; aapki gaadi ka exact time batate hain.
faq.q_en: How soon can I drive after a windshield replacement?
faq.a_en: The bonding needs a safe drive-away time, typically 1 to 3 hours; we tell you the exact time for your car.

faq.q_hi: Windshield badalne ke baad ADAS camera theek chalega?
faq.a_hi: Haan, agar windshield par lane-keep ya emergency braking camera laga hai to replacement ke baad recalibration hum karte hain.
faq.q_en: Do you recalibrate ADAS after windshield replacement?
faq.a_en: Yes, if your car has a windshield-mounted camera for lane-keep or emergency braking, we handle the recalibration after replacement.
